name: slimes-blessing-level-and-buff-counters
notes:
Slime's Blessing (ioxgugw9r9, ACTION): "[Class Bonus] This card costs 1 less to activate. Choose up to three units. Put a level counter on each chosen champion and a buff counter on each chosen Slime ally." ENGINE BUG (found, confirmed live, NOT fixed): this fixture documents the ability CURRENTLY silently losing every counter it was supposed to apply whenever the player declines before reaching 3 picks (the normal case any time fewer than 3 desirable targets exist, or the player simply doesn't want a 3rd pick).

Root cause (confirmed live via a standalone debug harness that replayed this exact sequence twice -- once declining the 3rd pick via PASS, once completing all 3 picks for real): SlimesBlessingAskTarget() (Custom/GameLogic.php ~21071) queues a paired MZMAYCHOOSE + CUSTOM 'SlimesBlessingChoose' decision for each pick; $customDQHandlers['SlimesBlessingChoose'] (~21112) is written to call SlimesBlessingResolve($player) when `$lastDecision === "PASS"` (i.e. the player declines), applying all counters accumulated so far. But Core/DecisionQueueController.php's ExecuteStaticMethods() CUSTOM case (~line 131) unconditionally does `if($lastDecision == "PASS" && !$decision->DontSkipOnPass) break;` -- it skips invoking ANY CUSTOM handler outright when the preceding decision's answer was "PASS", UNLESS that specific decision was queued with dontSkipOnPass=1. SlimesBlessingAskTarget's own `DecisionQueueController::AddDecision($player, "CUSTOM", "SlimesBlessingChoose", 1);` call (~21087) does NOT pass dontSkipOnPass, so the handler's own PASS-triggered resolve() branch is dead code -- it is never reached when the player actually declines. Confirmed live: after choosing 2 real targets then submitting PASS for the 3rd, SlimesBlessingChosen correctly accumulates both picks ('myField-0|myField-1') and the decision queue fully drains (AllQueuesEmpty=YES), but BOTH field objects' Counters stay empty ('[]') -- SlimesBlessingResolve() never ran. Re-running the identical setup but choosing a real 3rd target instead of PASS (myField-0, myField-1, theirField-0 -- all 3 picks) correctly applies both counters (Counters {"level":1} and {"buff":1}), because in that path SlimesBlessingChoose's OWN internal `if(count($chosen) >= 3) { SlimesBlessingResolve($player); return; }` branch calls Resolve() directly after being invoked with a REAL (non-PASS) lastDecision, never touching the dispatcher's PASS-skip guard at all. This isolates the defect precisely to the missing `dontSkipOnPass:1` on line ~21087's AddDecision call -- the exact same flag that Custom/MaterializeLogic.php sets on every one of its seven 'FINISHPAYMATERIALIZE' CUSTOM decisions for this identical reason (a PASS-aware CUSTOM handler that must still run after a decline). Any CUSTOM handler elsewhere in this codebase with its own internal PASS/"-"/"" check but missing this flag at its OWN queuing site would be equally dead on the decline path -- this is a copy-paste-omission class of bug, not unique to Slime's Blessing.

Slime's Blessing's element is WIND, not native to the 'Spirit of Fire' starting champion, so the champion's Subcards are patched with a real WIND champion (Spirit of Wind) purely to unlock element access. Red Slime (mttsvbgl6f, ALLY/SLIME) is seeded onto the field as the intended buff-counter target; the player's own champion (myField-0) is chosen as the intended level-counter target. Slime's Blessing is played for real from hand via FSM so its effect genuinely fires; the fixture's action sequence picks exactly 2 real targets then declines the offered 3rd pick with PASS -- the ordinary, common way a player would use this card with only 2 desired targets -- and the pinned assertions confirm the CURRENT (buggy) empty-Counters outcome as a regression baseline, matching the convention used for the Green Slime On-Leave bug elsewhere in this suite. The separate [Class Bonus] 'costs 1 less' discount clause is not reached (default champion has no class bonus) and is out of scope here.

rulesClauses: Choose up to three units. Put a level counter on each chosen champion and a buff counter on each chosen Slime ally.

engineBug.summary: Confirmed live with a standalone debug harness: SlimesBlessingAskTarget/SlimesBlessingChoose (Custom/GameLogic.php ~21071-21112) queue a CUSTOM 'SlimesBlessingChoose' decision without dontSkipOnPass=1. Core/DecisionQueueController.php's ExecuteStaticMethods() CUSTOM case unconditionally skips invoking any CUSTOM handler when the preceding answer was 'PASS' unless that decision was queued with dontSkipOnPass=1, so SlimesBlessingChoose's own PASS-triggered SlimesBlessingResolve() call is dead code whenever the player declines (or the loop auto-exhausts) before reaching 3 picks. All counters accumulated from any already-chosen targets are silently lost in that path. Choosing exactly 3 real targets (never declining) works correctly, because that path calls SlimesBlessingResolve() directly from inside the handler after a real (non-PASS) invocation, never touching the PASS-skip guard. The fix pattern already exists seven times elsewhere in this exact file (Custom/MaterializeLogic.php's 'FINISHPAYMATERIALIZE' CUSTOM decisions all pass dontSkipOnPass:1 for this identical reason).
engineBug.affectedFunction: SlimesBlessingAskTarget's AddDecision(..., "CUSTOM", "SlimesBlessingChoose", 1) call (Custom/GameLogic.php ~21087), missing dontSkipOnPass:1; dispatched through Core/DecisionQueueController.php's ExecuteStaticMethods() CUSTOM case (~line 131).
